name: learning-log-coach
description: Holds the school's Anthropic key for the Learning Log coach so students never do.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: From console.anthropic.com, an adult's account with the school card.

CLASS_TOKENS.description: Comma separated, one token per class or teacher, e.g. 2E3-MATH-bee7,3N1-SCI-hive2. Rotate each term.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: The site that serves logs/, no trailing slash, e.g. https://harmanjohll.github.io
